title: Cloud Queries with <algorithm>: centroid, stable sort, k-closest
hints: centroid: `std::accumulate(c.begin(), c.end(), Point3{0,0,0}, [](Point3 s, const Point3& p){ ... return s; })`. Watch the init type: an `int` 0 init would accumulate as int.
sortByRange: `std::stable_sort` with a comparator on **squared** range keeps the original order of equal ranges. Plain `std::sort` doesn't.
kClosest: `std::vector<std::size_t> idx(n); std::iota(idx.begin(), idx.end(), 0);`. Precompute the squared distances, then compare `(d2[a], a) < (d2[b], b)` so ties break by index.
`std::nth_element(idx.begin(), idx.begin() + k, idx.end(), cmp)` puts the k smallest in front in O(n). Then `std::sort` just those k and `resize(k)`. Clamp k to n first.
